source.post_text: In the USA, olive oil can be cut with cheaper seed oils, typically in food service, but it’s illegal to sell that blend as “100% olive oil” without disclosing it. Fraud and mislabeling can still happen overseas, so buy reputable, single origin, harvest dated EVOO, preferably produced and certified in the USA.

replies.text: Yeah solid advice, sticking to harvest-dated single-origin stuff from known US producers cuts the risk quite a bit compared to random imports.
